description: A lane's workflow.yaml under workflow contract 5, generated from the contract registry: each key's own value. The rules across keys, the step definitions, skills and placeholders are the lane loader's (`pf workflows validate`); docs/reference/workflow-contract.md.

acceptance.description: required|none (default required): whether a work item on the lane must list an acceptance criterion before it runs

tiers.description: map <tier> -> []<harness>:<model>[:<effort>]; the table a step's model_tier names

exclusive.description: bool (default false): one unfinished work item per project on the lane — a create on it reaches aihub exclusive, refused while another is not wrapped, failed or canceled

max_rewinds.description: int >= 0; required when any step declares on_fail, refused otherwise

tool_minutes.description: int > 0, <= 180, <= wall_minutes when both are declared: the step's own tool window

hub.description: map {verbs, attrs} (default none): what the step may call through `pf step hub`

attrs.description: []attrs key (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$), each at most once (default none): the top-level attrs keys the step may write (`pf step hub attrs <wi> --set <key>`); listing one lets the step call attrs, and the daemon refuses a write of any other key

verbs.description: []get|list|file|wrap-attrs|batch, each at most once (default none): the `pf step hub` verbs the step may call

model_tier.description: a tier of defaults.tiers; exclusive with model_candidates

resources.description: map {admission, locks}: what the daemon takes for the step's dispatch

admission.description: none|heavy (default none): a heavy-run admission slot for the dispatch

locks.description: []merge: the task repos' per-repo merge locks

skill.description: skill name: <lane>/skills/<name>.md, else _shared/skills/<name>.md, rendered into the prompt

skippable.description: bool (default false): a project may switch the step off with `steps.<project>.<step>.skip: true` in its workspace yaml, fixed when the work item is first claimed; a switched-off step is never dispatched (its execution status is skipped), and the wrap_attrs of skipped steps at the lane's end pass to the last step that runs

vars_files.description: map <var> -> a file of the lane (fragments/<name>.md), relative to the lane directory and inside it: the var's value is the file's text, exactly as if written in vars; a var is declared in vars or in vars_files, not both

waivable.description: bool (default false), gate only: the gate may hand off waive on the owner's word

wrap_attrs.description: []attr name (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$), each at most once (default none): the wrap attrs the step registers (`pf step hub wrap-attrs <name>`) before its round may hand off done; listing one lets the step call wrap-attrs. When the steps at the lane's end are skipped (a skippable step a project switched off), their wrap_attrs are the last running step's to register

title: workflow.yaml (workflow contract 5)
